name: Vat-Knit Flesh
description: At the end of each of your turns, recover 1 HP, up to your maximum. It does nothing while you are at 0 HP, and ember damage taken since your last turn stops the next recovery.

healingConfig.hotDuration: while above 0 HP, at the end of each of your turns

ancestry.limits: One recovery per turn, whatever the source. Never above maximum HP.
ancestry.counters: Ember damage taken since your last turn stops the next recovery.
